notes.title: Before official publish
notes.content:
"Developing a game by oneself is a holy difficult work"


1. The initial development of this work

From the beginning of January, I had a general idea, and then I spent a lot of time looking up research literature on autism, film and television materials, and consulting a number of real autistic people (not the kind of self-defeating people Patients with autism), began to develop.

The original intention summary is actually very simple: tell a story, a story that makes people think.

Family, friendship, love, to be honest, these things are hard to touch, but they really exist around most of us. However, for those people who with autism, it's hard to understand what it is.

So how to express those feelings is a headache for me. If you have any thoughts or suggestions on the content and plot, please let me know, thank you very much.


2. Why was the name "Firefly"
common point.


3. Is this a tragic story or?
This is a story with multiple endings.


4. WRONG WORD!  Stroy 
No, no, no, this is not wrong.
My or your story is correct story, but for a few people, no.


5. Specific release time
In order to complete the details, it may be at the end of September or mid-October.
It might be later.
